prompt: Which is the first state in India to operationalize an ABDM microsite under the 100 Microsites Project by the National Health Authority?
answer: Mizoram was the first state in India to operationalize an ABDM microsite under the National Health Authority’s 100 Microsites Project. The microsite was launched in Aizawl in August 2023.
